profile.summary: Diversity in Leadership Institute is a nonprofit based in Los Angeles that identifies, develops and supports racially diverse public school leaders. Its work includes a fellowship program for aspiring principals of color, consulting services for school districts and charter schools, and coalition building and advocacy to close opportunity gaps for students.
